items.source: Provider for asynchronous stateless MCP resource methods. This provider creates resource specifications for methods annotated with McpResource that are designed to work in a stateless manner using McpTransportContext and return reactive types.
items.translation: 用于异步无状态 MCP 资源方法的提供者。 此提供者会为使用 McpResource 注解且设计为通过 McpTransportContext 以无状态方式工作并返回反应式类型的方法创建资源规范。

items.source: resourceObjects - the objects containing methods annotated with McpResource
items.translation: resourceObjects - 包含用 McpResource 注解的方法的对象。
